Wall time: 13.1 µs', a single noisy run, not a timing loop. Only one cell uses %timeit and shows 'per loop', so the two can't be compared the way the step teaches.

step.title: Time two ways of summing with %timeit
step.instructions: In steps.ipynb, add two cells: one with %timeit sum(steps), and one that makes steps_array = np.array(steps) and runs %timeit np.sum(steps_array). Run both (Shift+Enter) and compare the timings under them.
step.code:
%timeit sum(steps)

import numpy as np
steps_array = np.array(steps)
%timeit np.sum(steps_array)
